title: B2Chat
description:
B2Chat is a multimillion dollar business communication platform based in Spain that provides tools for customer support, sales, and engagement. It allows businesses to interact with customers through various channels, such as live chat, chatbots, and messaging apps (for example, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Telegram). The platform is designed to help companies streamline communication, improve response times, and enhance customer satisfaction.

This leak includes sensitive financial information, employees' names, emails, and phone numbers, as well as clients' and partners' data.

If you do not pay the ransom, we will contact and attack your employees, clients, and partners to destroy your business. [Sector: Technology]
